rulesTestNames: denies every client read and write on organizerReferrals
read: server only; the attach transaction, the bill paid transactions, and the cycle bill run and its recompute
write: create-only when a referred organizer has an owner and its trial has not started, in the same transaction that raises its commercial terms override trial.days to at least 60; reward.status moves pending to earned in the transaction that marks the referred organizer's first bill paid, and earned to applied (or back, when a recomputed free bill has nothing left to waive) in the transaction that writes the referrer's free cycle bill
migrationNotes: New collection (owner decision 19 Nov 2026), keyed by the referred organizer; no backfill: referrals attach from referral leads linked after this ships, or within the daily reconcile window for claims and links in the last three days.
